review_locator: PMCID:PMC2965564, From the cradle to the grave: activities of GATA-3 throughout T cell development and differentiation
primary_title: GATA-3 suppresses Th1 development by downregulation of Stat4 and not through effects on IL-12Rbeta2 chain or T-bet
decision_basis: The review identifies STAT4 transcription as a GATA3-repressed Th1 program component; the cited primary shows retroviral GATA3 expression in developing Th1 cells downregulates Stat4, while enforced STAT4 restores Th1 conversion despite GATA3 expression.
limitations_preserved: Promote only gene-expression repression in the tested helper-T-cell differentiation context. The primary does not establish direct GATA3 occupancy at the Stat4 promoter; do not infer IL-12 receptor signaling, IFNG protein, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC2965564, From the cradle to the grave: activities of GATA-3 throughout T cell development and differentiation
primary_title: GATA-3 suppresses IFN-gamma promoter activity independently of binding to cis-regulatory elements
decision_basis: The review identifies IFNG as a GATA3-repressed Th1 output; the cited primary shows GATA3 overexpression suppresses IFNG promoter activity and mRNA, GATA3 reduction increases IFNG expression, and the mechanism is linked to GATA3-mediated downregulation of STAT4 rather than direct use of GATA elements in the IFNG regulatory region.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the bounded indirect gene-repression edge. Preserve that STAT4 downregulation is the demonstrated mechanism and that GATA3 does not directly repress the IFNG cis-elements in this study; do not infer IFN-gamma secretion, receptor signaling, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.
